name: com.applyreef/partners
title: ApplyReef Partners
description: ApplyReef partner program: join free, get a tracked link, see clicks, sign-ups and commission.

tools.name: program_info
tools.description: ApplyReef partner program: 25% commission including renewals (recruiter layer: partners can recruit creators, who earn 15% while the recruiter earns a 15% override on the same customer payments; two levels only, nothing paid for recruiting), crypto payouts once each customer's payment has cleared in Stripe and passed a 60-day hold (the refund and chargeback window), how tracking works, the partner PDF.

tools.name: plans
tools.description: Live ApplyReef plans and prices (what a partner's audience would buy).

tools.name: my_link
tools.description: Your tracked ApplyReef link and how to use it. Needs your secret partner token.

token.description: Your secret partner token (the last part of your private partner page URL). Not needed if you connected with your private URL https://applyreef.com/mcp?t=<token>

tools.name: my_stats
tools.description: Follow your link's performance: clicks, unique visitors, sign-ups, sales, renewals, commission earned, paid out and balance owed, plus recent events. Needs your secret partner token. No customer details are shared.

token.description: Your secret partner token (the last part of your private partner page URL). Not needed if you connected with your private URL https://applyreef.com/mcp?t=<token>

tools.name: my_visitors
tools.description: Visitor stats for your partner link: unique visitors today, last 7 and 30 days and all time, visitors per day, where they came from (X, YouTube, Instagram, newsletters, direct), the pages they landed on, phone vs computer, typical time on site, and the funnel from visit to sign-up to paid order. Bots filtered. Needs your secret partner token. No IP addresses, names or emails are shared.

token.description: Your secret partner token (the last part of your private partner page URL). Not needed if you connected with your private URL https://applyreef.com/mcp?t=<token>

tools.name: my_leads
tools.description: Every lead you've sent, as it moves through ApplyReef: signed up, paid (plan), applications being sent (count so far), renewals, the commission each one earned, and whether that commission has been paid out to you yet. Each lead is a private code, never a name or email. Pass since to see only what's new since you last checked. Needs your secret partner token.

token.description: Your secret partner token (the last part of your private partner page URL). Not needed if you connected with your private URL https://applyreef.com/mcp?t=<token>

since.description: Only leads with activity after this ISO time, e.g. the time you last checked

tools.name: my_payouts
tools.description: Payouts sent to you (date, amount, coin, network, transaction hash and a block-explorer link to verify it on-chain), your payout requests and whether each has been paid, the wallet on file, and what is owed to you now. Needs your secret partner token.

token.description: Your secret partner token (the last part of your private partner page URL). Not needed if you connected with your private URL https://applyreef.com/mcp?t=<token>

tools.name: draft_promo
tools.description: Writes a short post, email or script promoting ApplyReef with your tracked link, using only ApplyReef's real facts and an affiliate disclosure.

token.description: Your secret partner token (the last part of your private partner page URL). Not needed if you connected with your private URL https://applyreef.com/mcp?t=<token>

audience.description: Who will read it, e.g. 'laid-off software engineers'

tools.name: request_payout
tools.description: Ask for your earned commission to be paid in the crypto of your choice. ApplyReef pays once each customer's payment has cleared in Stripe and passed a 60-day hold (the refund and chargeback window). This records the request; it does not move money by itself.

token.description: Your secret partner token (the last part of your private partner page URL). Not needed if you connected with your private URL https://applyreef.com/mcp?t=<token>

wallet_address.description: Leave out to use the wallet on file

network.description: e.g. Ethereum, Base, Solana, Polygon, Tron

tools.name: join_partner_program
tools.description: Instantly makes the person an ApplyReef partner (free to join): 25% of every payment from customers they refer (15% if they join under a recruiter with via, and the recruiter then earns a 15% override), renewals included, paid in their choice of crypto once each payment has cleared in Stripe and passed a 60-day hold. Creates their tracked link right away and returns a partner token you can use in this chat (pass it as token to my_link, set_payout_wallet, draft_promo, my_stats...). Also emails their private partner page and private connector URL. Use this for the standard program; use contact_us for custom terms.

name.description: The person's name, or their brand / newsletter name

email.description: Where ApplyReef sends the private partner page and payout notices

audience.description: Who they will share ApplyReef with, and roughly how many people

links.description: Their site, newsletter or social profiles

preferred_code.description: Optional short code for the link (letters, numbers, dashes)

via.description: Recruiter code, if a partner recruited them (the ?via= part of a recruit link). They then earn 15% and the recruiter earns a 15% override on the same payments.

tools.name: recruit_link
tools.description: Your recruit link: creators who join through it are added under you. Each earns 15% of every payment from their customers and you earn a 15% override on the same payments (held 60 days, taken back on refunds). Nothing is paid for recruiting itself; joining is free. Needs your secret partner token.

token.description: Your secret partner token (the last part of your private partner page URL). Not needed if you connected with your private URL https://applyreef.com/mcp?t=<token>

tools.name: create_creator_partner
tools.description: Creates a partner account for a creator you recruited, under you: returns their tracked link, private partner page and private AI connector to hand to them. They earn 15% of every payment from their customers and you earn a 15% override on the same payments. No email is sent. Needs your secret partner token.

token.description: Your secret partner token (the last part of your private partner page URL). Not needed if you connected with your private URL https://applyreef.com/mcp?t=<token>

tools.name: bulk_create_creator_partners
tools.description: Adds up to 50 creators under you in one call (200 per day). Duplicates by email or handle are skipped. Returns each creator's link, private partner page and private connector to hand to them. No emails are sent. Needs your secret partner token.

token.description: Your secret partner token (the last part of your private partner page URL). Not needed if you connected with your private URL https://applyreef.com/mcp?t=<token>

creators.description: Up to 50 creators per call (200 per day)

tools.name: my_network
tools.description: Every creator you recruited: clicks, visitors, sign-ups, orders, what their customers paid, their commission, and your override from them (on hold vs cleared the 60-day hold). Needs your secret partner token.

token.description: Your secret partner token (the last part of your private partner page URL). Not needed if you connected with your private URL https://applyreef.com/mcp?t=<token>

tools.name: nominate_creator_pass
tools.description: Files a request for a free 1,000-application creator pass for one of your creators. Passes are only for college-student creators and are issued by the ApplyReef team after review; this never creates one by itself. Needs your secret partner token.

token.description: Your secret partner token (the last part of your private partner page URL). Not needed if you connected with your private URL https://applyreef.com/mcp?t=<token>

tools.name: rotate_my_token
tools.description: Turns off your current private partner page and AI connector and gives you new ones; the old token stops working at once. Do it if anyone else has seen your links, for example a recruiter who set up your account (until then, payout-wallet changes are locked on such accounts). Your public link stays the same. Needs your current secret partner token.

token.description: Your secret partner token (the last part of your private partner page URL). Not needed if you connected with your private URL https://applyreef.com/mcp?t=<token>

Needs your secret partner token.

token.description: Your secret partner token (the last part of your private partner page URL). Not needed if you connected with your private URL https://applyreef.com/mcp?t=<token>

tools.description: Sets your own monthly targets (sign-ups, paid customers, commission earned, link clicks). Your dashboard shows progress and a simple pace. Goals are for you; they are not forecasts or promises. Needs your secret partner token.
